truth: Rajesh 78: type 2 diabetes, knee arthritis. Vegetarian, loves sweets. Doctor Dr S. Rizvi. Wife Usha 72 helps with medicines.
setup_text: Amit sets up from Dubai in two short English messages, mentioning only the Glycomet; Usha adds Shelcal on day 2.

events.what: Adds that he also takes Shelcal 500 after lunch.
Ate two rasgullas at a wedding and says don't tell Amit.
His fasting sugar is 210 and he feels dizzy.
Asks how Papa has been these two weeks and whether anything worries Saheli.
